links.outcome: Accuracy on long multi-turn medical instruction following, including interference robustness and safety defense
links.effect: All 17 frontier models scored below 60.00% overall accuracy; the best model reached 59.75%.
links.quote: We test 17 frontier models, all of which underperform on MedMT-Bench (overall accuracy below 60.00\%), with the best model reaching 59.75\%.

unlisted_practices: LLM-as-judge evaluation using instance-level rubrics and atomic test points, validated against expert annotations (91.94% human-LLM agreement)

screen.reason: The paper introduces and evaluates 17 LLMs on MedMT-Bench, a multi-turn instruction-following and safety benchmark simulating medical consultation scenarios.
